reason: A terminal-native TUI plugin for DSH that provides an interactive agent chat interface, session controls, status visualization, file and image input, and integrations with DSH tools and services.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供终端原生的智能体交互界面，支持流式对话、会话管理、状态与上下文可视化，以及文件和图片输入。
summaries.en: A terminal-native DSH agent interface supporting streaming conversations, session management, status and context visualization, and file or image input.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal user interface for agent conversations and session management
Displays streaming responses, agent status, context usage, token metrics, and tool details
Supports file completion, file references, image attachments, clipboard input, and browser link opening
Connects to DSH services, model providers, Skills, MCP servers, presets, goals, todos, and subagents
Supports session resume, fork or rewind, compaction, export, model switching, and tool approval prompts
Checks for package updates and can update the active runtime profile
